note: Each requirement is restated from the user's brief (session message). Requirements are not factual claims, so their 'Source' column points to the brief. 'Status' is what this session has delivered; 'Partial' or 'Blocked' rows are explained.

rows.requirement: Collect, organise and analyse NFL information against a full requirements list
rows.how_addressed: The root dashboard and 14-page Signals section organize Week 10 availability, schedule/standings references, requirements and research proposals. No historical odds or strategy-performance dataset is connected.

rows.requirement: Suggestions to improve decision making, in a dedicated section that can be reviewed before any change
rows.how_addressed: Root Suggestions page offers browser-local choices; Signals suggestions use explicit proposal/status fields. Local choices do not change code or authorize data collection.

rows.requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before decisions
rows.how_addressed: Questions page: known / missing / how to discover, per question.

rows.requirement: Originate own NFL lines
rows.how_addressed: A fair-price and joint-probability blueprint is documented, but no numerical line can be fitted without verified historical outcomes and licensed timestamped odds.

rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
rows.how_addressed: The Signals section lists 16 hypotheses with inputs, vetoes and falsification plans; none has a measured edge or has passed validation.

rows.requirement: Leaderboard competition with rewards for top strategies
rows.how_addressed: Leaderboard and reward governance are documented in Signals, with non-cash reward proposals; the board has no entries and no reward contest is active.

rows.requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop combos
rows.how_addressed: Single bets, parlays and player-prop combos are covered in the root strategy framework and Signals catalogue. Market availability, settlement and policy remain open.

rows.requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates
rows.how_addressed: Root gates and 15 Signals gates define a validation process; several thresholds and required inputs are missing, so no strategy has passed.

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values
rows.how_addressed: Signals registers 11 correlation pairs and a measurement protocol, but every measured value and interval remains null; no historical joint outcomes are loaded.

rows.requirement: Remove luck from the equation; build selectively skill-based strategies
rows.how_addressed: Signals documents CLV-first evaluation, chronological walk-forward, sample sufficiency, multiple-testing and robustness gates. No empirical test has been run.

rows.requirement: Track injuries, including official status by player
rows.how_addressed: Root dashboard contains the official Week 10 2026 all-status snapshot; Signals publishes a separately captured Out/Doubtful snapshot with reconciliation checks. Neither is a live feed.

rows.requirement: Identify defensive depth deficiencies (2nd/3rd/4th string replacing starters)
rows.how_addressed: Injuries page now includes blank, source-linked offense/defense slots for second-, third-, and fourth-string players. No team, player, tier, injury impact, or deficiency is asserted; official depth evidence remains open (Q-10).

rows.requirement: Identify offensive depth deficiencies (starters or backups)
rows.how_addressed: Same blank replacement-chain schema covers offensive roles. Actual roles, snap shares, and replacement effects remain blank until officially sourced and evaluated.

rows.requirement: Executive summary with important details
rows.how_addressed: Executive summary page and landing page.

rows.requirement: Repo review line by line with official links and flagged irregularities
rows.how_addressed: Repo review page; irregularities listed on Flagged page.

rows.requirement: GitHub Pages live site: clean landing page and category subpages, simple dashboard, all entries in tables
rows.how_addressed: GitHub Pages serves the research dashboard and the separate 14-page Signals & origination section with category navigation.

rows.requirement: Every table row has a source link to an official site; unverifiable values left blank and flagged
rows.how_addressed: Root validator requires official HTTPS links on factual/source tables; Signals builder and integrity checker validate sourced rows and links. User-brief/diagnostic rows are explicit non-factual exceptions.

rows.requirement: Coordination file with task board and log
rows.how_addressed: COORDINATION.md.

rows.requirement: Pull request from integration branch to main, merge, confirm Pages deploy
rows.how_addressed: The Pages workflow verifies pull requests and builds before deploying main. Final PR merge and GitHub Pages confirmation are tracked in COORDINATION.md.

rows.requirement: Flagged for Review page with source links, not blocking merge
rows.how_addressed: Flagged for Review page.
